entry.title: Python 3.14 beta: что нового для разработчиков данных
entry.summary:
Вышел Python 3.14 beta. Обсуждаем изменения в asyncio, улучшения typing и новинки стандартной библиотеки. Для аналитиков данных важны ускорения pandas и numpy на новых версиях интерпретатора, а также улучшения в multiprocessing.

Полный список изменений доступен в changelog. Контакты: release@python.org

entry.title: PyPI security update: token-based uploads now required
entry.summary: PyPI now requires API tokens for all package uploads. Legacy password authentication is disabled. Maintainers must configure tokens in their CI pipelines and rotate secrets regularly. The change reduces the risk of supply-chain attacks and improves auditability of package publishing.

entry.title: Announcing a new asyncio debugging tool
entry.summary: A new asyncio debugging tool helps developers inspect task trees, find blocked coroutines and trace event-loop stalls. It integrates with the standard debugger and shows where a task was created. For data pipelines built on asyncio this simplifies diagnosing slow consumers and deadlocks in interview queues.

entry.title: Pandas 3.0 roadmap highlights
entry.summary: The pandas 3.0 roadmap focuses on copy-on-write semantics, better arrow integration and a cleaner API for string operations. Data engineers will benefit from lower memory usage and predictable performance when transforming large dataset tables in ETL pipelines.
